source: Cloudflare Billable Usage dashboard, authenticated read-only view

attribution.method: Subtract fixture writes from the same pre-cleanup analytics counter. The result is below the shared 50-million-write allowance.
attribution.limits: The dashboard is account-wide and delayed. Resource analytics are not invoice line items. The R2 storage charge has no project-level byte-month attribution here. The projected cycle cost extrapolates a one-off synthetic spike and is not a recurring Visonaut forecast.
